attchmntText: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited has informed the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited that the audio recording of the earnings conference call regarding the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, is available on the company website. The recording is accessible via the provided link. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 46(2) (oa) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company secretary and compliance officer, Jishnu RG, submitted this notice on November 11, 2026.

attchmntText: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited filed an investor and analyst presentation regarding its standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The presentation is available on the company website. The document outlines the company's history, investment highlights, strategic priorities, and performance summary. It details the Indian jewellery market size at 7,204 billion rupees and the company's presence with 33 showrooms in Kerala, 504 in South India, 38 in North India, 2 in West India, and 2 in East India. The company operates 1,203 stores in India and has a global presence. Financial metrics mentioned include revenue figures in millions of rupees for various segments. The presentation covers Q2FY27 and H1FY27 performance for India, Middle East, and consolidated operations. It also discusses the franchise model and asset-light journey.

attchmntText: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "Press Release".
voiceSummary: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of Rs 20,912 crore for the first half of FY27, representing 38% growth from Rs 15,125 crore in the prior year. Consolidated profit after tax for the same period was Rs 776 crore, up 48% from Rs 525 crore. For the second quarter of FY27, consolidated revenue was Rs 10,323 crore and profit after tax was Rs 427 crore. Standalone revenue for the second quarter was Rs 9,007 crore with a profit after tax of Rs 424 crore. The intimation was submitted to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on November 10, 2026.

attchmntText: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited announced the approval of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on November 10, 2026. The statutory auditors, Walker Chandiok & Co LLP, issued a limited review report stating that the financial statements comply with applicable accounting standards and regulations. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported revenue from operations of 1,81,870.99 million rupees. Profit after tax for the same period was 11,324.12 million rupees. Basic earnings per share stood at 10.95 rupees. The company also disclosed its standalone balance sheet and cash flow statement for the period.
